model.likelihood: Gaussian log GBD rate; no Poisson likelihood for model-derived counts
model.states: age-specific level and slope with correlated Gaussian innovations
model.age_kernel: 0.8 * exp(-0.5 * squared ordinal-age distance / lengthscale^2) + 0.2 * identity
model.grid_prior: equal prior probability on all 162 combinations; integrate using training marginal likelihood
model.initialisation: condition on first observed log-rate vector: level mean equals it, level covariance observation variance times identity; slope mean zero and covariance 0.02^2 times age kernel; zero cross-covariance
model.inference: exact Gaussian Kalman recursions for each grid component; discrete Bayesian model averaging
model.point_forecast: marginal predictive median transformed to rate
model.posterior_scope: conditional on model grid and GBD historical point estimates; excludes GBD source-estimation and external population uncertainty

evaluation.point_loss: equal-age mean absolute log error; sex-specific; endpoint and rolling origins
evaluation.oldest_age_diagnostics: 80+ rate coverage, count and burden-share errors and coverage
evaluation.derived_burden: same frozen operational population forecasts for all methods; rate-only conditional intervals identified separately from joint residual rate/population intervals

stopping_rule.reruns: only documented implementation or data-integrity corrections, retaining prior artifacts
stopping_rule.new_data: external data acquisition may continue; independent validation requires documented ascertainment and population coverage
stopping_rule.younger_age_extension: requires separate specification after data audit; excluded from this extension
stopping_rule.manuscript: results do not replace original primary findings; no automatic success claim
